R6.note: governor off: both draw the same budget; submit -> done is GPU time per frame (WebGPU onSubmittedWorkDone), which also moves with the GPU clock (the driver lowers it at a light load); the display caps drawn frames at its rate; frames held = the GPU still had 2 frames in flight
